Hi Jason,

Thanks for doing those tests, they tell us a lot. The power supply is fine on its own, and the pop only happens once it is connected to the miner. That points at a short on the miner's board rather than the brick, which is a warranty fault, not something to keep testing. Please leave it unplugged from here on.

Your NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 came from order Shop····, delivered on June 19. I have passed the fault and your test results straight to JD, our hardware lead, for the return approval. A colleague is picking it up today, and as soon as it is approved I will send you the prepaid return label and the reference to write on the box, and sort the replacement from there.

One thing I need from you in the meantime: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Units running modified settings are not covered, so I just need your yes or no on the record.

If you want a faster hands-on answer while that runs, JD is very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, his username there is @nullhashrate. Either way you will get his answer here too.

Sorry for the trouble with it, Jason. I will come back to you as soon as I have the approval.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Please keep it unplugged in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

No, and I am not going to dress that up. Your unit was confirmed faulty on October 30, you sent everything I asked for on Monday, and the sign-off from our hardware lead still has not landed. That is on us, not on you. I have pushed it again today and a colleague is on it now.

Nothing else is waiting on you. The return is set up as Shop···· to our Chattanooga warehouse and the prepaid label is ready to buy the moment the approval is in, and I will send it straight to you here.

For the hassle of the week I have made you a code for a future order, HD-••••••, which is $25 off and works on orders over $100. It is yours alone. It does not fix the wait, but it is the one thing I could do today without asking anyone.

Thanks for staying patient with this, Jason.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
